title: Validation failures return 422, not the 400 named in the requirement's verification hint
evidence: handlers.go:121 writes http.StatusUnprocessableEntity for missing title/author; handlers_test.go:160-161 asserts 422. Malformed JSON still returns 400 (handlers.go:88). The request is rejected with a JSON error body, so R9 is implemented.
suggestion: No change needed for the spec; return 400 only if a client contract requires it.

title: go.mod marks the directly imported modernc.org/sqlite as // indirect
evidence: go.mod:15 'modernc.org/sqlite v1.60.1 // indirect' while store.go:7 imports it directly; every require in go.mod:5-16 is tagged indirect
suggestion: Run go mod tidy so the direct dependency is listed without the indirect marker.

title: README states Go 1.22 or newer but go.mod requires go 1.26.6
suggestion: Lower the go directive to 1.22 or correct the README's stated minimum.

title: Tests discard json.Unmarshal errors
evidence: handlers_test.go:61, 136, 143, 189 call json.Unmarshal without checking the returned error; a malformed body would surface only as a misleading length/field assertion
suggestion: Check the error (or reuse a must-decode helper like mustBook at handlers_test.go:45).

title: Extras beyond the spec: graceful shutdown, 1 MiB body limit, Location header, DB-backed health check, year range validation
evidence: main.go:40-49 signal-driven Shutdown; handlers.go:14,79 MaxBytesReader; handlers.go:146 Location header; handlers.go:56 store.Ping in /health; handlers.go:117 year 0-9999 check
